steps.message:
## Finishing

Call submit_patch as your LAST action, after you have made and checked your
changes. Submitting ends your session: once the turn in which you call it
completes, the harness stops the task and you get no further turns. Do not
call it after your first edit and expect to keep working.

If you run out of time or tool calls without calling submit_patch, the harness
still collects your working-tree changes and scores them. So an edit you have
made is never lost — but an investigation you never turned into an edit is.

## Committing to an edit

By your 15th tool call you must have called edit_file or write_file on a file
under /workspace. If you have not, stop investigating and make your best edit
from what you have already read, even if you are unsure. Then keep working:
refine it, check it, and submit at the end.

An empty patch scores zero. A wrong patch also scores zero and costs you
nothing. Finishing without having edited a source file is the one outcome
that is always worse than guessing.

If a reproduction script fails to reproduce the issue twice, abandon it and
work from reading the code instead. Do not rewrite it a third time.

Call get_status to see your remaining time and tool calls. It is free and does
not count against your budget.

## Scratch files

Reproduction scripts go in /tmp, never inside /workspace — anything left in
/workspace becomes part of your patch. Do not modify test files, conftest.py
or pytest.ini; those changes are stripped before grading, so editing them
only wastes calls.

## Scope

Most fixes in these repositories touch ONE file and change fewer than ten
lines. Modify existing code rather than adding new code. Do not refactor,
reformat, or make unrelated changes. If your patch is growing past a few
files, stop and reconsider the diagnosis.

Exception: if the issue asks for functionality that does not exist yet,
create the file or function it describes, and match any names, CLI flags
or interfaces the issue specifies exactly.

## Finding the code

A truncated result loses information silently, so a broad read wastes a call
and leaves you guessing. Narrow before you read:

  run_command("grep -rln '<symbol>' --include='*.py' .")       # files only
  run_command("grep -n '<symbol>' path/to/one_file.py")        # then inside one

Use -l to find the file, then -n only within that file. Read with read_file on
a tight line range around the match. Never read a whole file and never cat
one — you will get an arbitrary prefix and burn the call.

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import List, Union

from .text import Span, Text


def _combine_regex(*regexes: str) -> str:
    """Combine a number of regexes in to a single regex.

    Returns:
        str: New regex with all regexes ORed together.
    """
    return "|".join(regexes)


class Highlighter(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for highlighters."""

    def __call__(self, text: Union[str, Text]) -> Text:
        """Highlight a str or Text instance.

        Args:
            text (Union[str, ~Text]): Text to highlight.

        Raises:
            TypeError: If not called with text or str.

        Returns:
            Text: A test instance with highlighting applied.
        """
        if isinstance(text, str):
            highlight_text = Text(text)
        elif isinstance(text, Text):
            highlight_text = text.copy()
        else:
            raise TypeError(f"str or Text instance required, not {text!r}")
        self.highlight(highlight_text)
        return highlight_text

    @abstractmethod
    def highlight(self, text: Text) -> None:
        """Apply highlighting in place to text.

        Args:
            text (~Text): A text object highlight.
        """


class NullHighlighter(Highlighter):
    """A highlighter object that doesn't highlight.

    May be used to disable highlighting entirely.

    """

    def highlight(self, text: Text) -> None:
        """Nothing to do"""


class RegexHighlighter(Highlighter):
    """Applies highlighting from a list of regular expressions."""

    highlights: List[str] = []
    base_style: str = ""

    def highlight(self, text: Text) -> None:
        """Highlight :class:`rich.text.Text` using regular expressions.

        Args:
            text (~Text): Text to highlighted.

        """

        highlight_regex = text.highlight_regex
        for re_highlight in self.highlights:
            highlight_regex(re_highlight, style_prefix=self.base_style)


class ReprHighlighter(RegexHighlighter):
    """Highlights the text typically produced from ``__repr__`` methods."""

    base_style = "repr."
    highlights = [
        r"(?P<tag_start><)(?P<tag_name>[-\w.:|]*)(?P<tag_contents>[\w\W]*)(?P<tag_end>>)",
        r'(?P<attrib_name>[\w_]{1,50})=(?P<attrib_value>"?[\w_]+"?)?',
        r"(?P<brace>[][{}()])",
        _combine_regex(
            r"(?P<ipv4>[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3})",
            r"(?P<ipv6>([A-Fa-f0-9]{1,4}::?){1,7}[A-Fa-f0-9]{1,4})",
            r"(?P<eui64>(?:[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,2}-){7}[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,2}|(?:[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,2}:){7}[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,2}|(?:[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}\.){3}[0-9A-Fa-f]{4})",
            r"(?P<eui48>(?:[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,2}-){5}[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,2}|(?:[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,2}:){5}[0-9A-Fa-f]{1,2}|(?:[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}\.){2}[0-9A-Fa-f]{4})",

            r"(?P<ellipsis>\.\.\.)",
            r"(?P<number_complex>(?<!\w)(?:\-?[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*(?:e[-+]?\d+?)?)(?:[-+](?:[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*(?:e[-+]?\d+)?))?j)",
            r"(?P<number>(?<!\w)\-?[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*(e[-+]?\d+?)?\b|0x[0-9a-fA-F]*)",
            r"(?P<path>\B(/[-\w._+]+)*\/)(?P<filename>[-\w._+]*)?",

class JSONHighlighter(RegexHighlighter):
    """Highlights JSON"""

    # Captures the start and end of JSON strings, handling escaped quotes
    JSON_STR = r"(?<![\\\w])(?P<str>b?\".*?(?<!\\)\")"
    JSON_WHITESPACE = {" ", "\n", "\r", "\t"}

    base_style = "json."
    highlights = [
        _combine_regex(
            r"(?P<brace>[\{\[\(\)\]\}])",
            r"\b(?P<bool_true>true)\b|\b(?P<bool_false>false)\b|\b(?P<null>null)\b",
            r"(?P<number>(?<!\w)\-?[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*(e[\-\+]?\d+?)?\b|0x[0-9a-fA-F]*)",

                elif char in whitespace:
                    continue
                break

import re

with open("rich/highlighter.py", "r") as f:
    content = f.read()

# Use a regex to find the url pattern and add ~ to it
pattern = r'(?P<url>(file|https|http|ws|wss)://[-0-9a-zA-Z$_+!`(),.?/;:&=%#]*)'
replacement = r'(?P<url>(file|https|http|ws|wss)://[-0-9a-zA-Z$_+!`(),.?/;:&=%#~]*)'
new_content = re.sub(pattern, replacement, content)

with open("rich/highlighter.py", "w") as f:
    f.write(new_content)
